text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day that Nakayama Festa
and I leave
for France.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is as far as I'll be going!
The rest is
up to you
two, got it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You don't need to escort me any
further.
That goes for you too, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Do your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why do you have to act so dramatic
when I
haven't even left yet?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homer...
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Festa... go out there and make
an effort
you won't regret.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homer...
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I really would love to come and
watch you,
but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's fine, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Watch it from here. Every last second.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homer...
text_block_list.text:
Of course I will. You can't win your
gamble if I
don't.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text: Festa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Mom? What's wrong? Why did you come
running
over?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I thought I wasn't going to make it!
Here, I
brought you a boxed lunch to
take with you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd get hungry waiting for
the plane, so go ahead and eat it with
your trainer. And
don't go causing too
much trouble!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Uh... huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa appears too bewildered
to
respond, so I take the bag from her
mother
instead.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's no trouble. Please take good care of
her!
And...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text: Try not to get injured, Festa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After saying goodbye to everyone, we
pass
through security and sit down to
wait in the
airport lounge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We don't have enough time to finish it.
choice_data_list: Wanna eat the bento from your mom?
Want to eat the bento from your mom?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's enjoy it properly once we're on the
plane.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: In the past...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I imagine my folks had a pretty hard
time with me. All of a sudden the sweet
girl they once knew was
running amok
getting into trouble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm the oldest, so it must've really
been
shocking for Mom to see that
happening for the
first time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Up until then, we were a perfectly
ordinary family. At most, Mom would
occasionally complain that Dad wasn't
making enough cash
and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then all of a sudden, they were being
forced to visit school to apologize and
spending each day
dealing with a
difficult daughter.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But, they didn't complain even once
when I said I
wanted to join a racing
school.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
They never ever missed a single
payment. They
had the entrance fee
ready for my enrollment and
everything.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: They've been cheering for you all ...
They've been cheering for you all ...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's crazy how much I'm surrounded by
such kind
people.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's the only thing I can do.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Let's seize the best possible results.
